global.title: Rocket Lab launches 13th Synspective satellite
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Rocket Lab continued a rapid pace of Electron launches with another mission for Japanese radar-imaging company Synspective on Sept. 25.
global.why: Kept so the editor has a record of what was reported, not because a full desk sweep was done.

global.title: U.S. secures authority for Golden Dome missile defense in Greenland
global.summary: WASHINGTON — The United States has secured authority to establish Golden Dome missile-defense capabilities in Greenland, opening the way for the Pentagon to expand a homeland defense network around Pituffik Space Base, where the U.S. Space Force already operates a ballistic missile warning radar.
global.why: Kept so the editor has a record of what was reported, not because a full desk sweep was done.

global.title: KBR taps veteran defense executive to lead Trinzic spinoff
global.summary: WASHINGTON — KBR is putting a veteran defense executive in charge of a $5 billion-plus government technology business as it prepares to spin off operations spanning national security, NASA and military space into an independent public company.
